head: U-nut (spring/clip nut), .44 wide x .62-.65 long, for .03-.06 panel
notes: AMK B-12245 (also BFC 382656-S2). AMK says .65 long, camaros.net says .62, so a range. Some vendors call it a J-nut (63-67 headlight bezel). Dr Rebuild sells a 68-69 Corvette grille kit as a repro of 9422654. AMK finish shown as phosphate (& oil).
